Method of Attack: Hijacking ongoing email conversations to insert malicious documents
Exploiting CVE-2017-0199 vulnerability in Word documents to download and run malware
First-stage malware PoohMilk establishes persistence and downloads second-stage malware Freenki
Freenki performs reconnaissance and downloads a third-stage payload
Impacted Systems: Bank based in the Middle East
Trademark and intellectual property service companies in Europe
Individuals with indirect ties to a country in North East Asia
North Korean defectors hiding in the UK
Attack Vector: Compromised email accounts participating in ongoing email threads
Malicious Word document attachments in email conversations
